proved_obstructions.scope: Fewer than r rational-coefficient polynomial integer-value tests cannot recognize all of Z^r inside Q^r.
proved_obstructions.witness_strength: Infinitely many denominator primes; unbounded prime-power denominator exponents.
proved_obstructions.does_not_exclude: Shared existential witnesses or additional equations of a particular source system.

proved_obstructions.scope: A finite algebra over one input-independent rational base parameter cannot cover the required infinite subset of the specified restriction-of-scalars cyclic orbit.
proved_obstructions.does_not_exclude: Charts depending on the existing input; other integrality constructions; any global variable bound.

proved_obstructions.scope: 139 new coordinates are necessary and sufficient for b^(5^60) from 1,b,b^2 in the stated triangular quadratic binomial Laurent model, allowing negative and fractional exponents.
proved_obstructions.does_not_exclude: Nonmonomial intermediates, nontriangular systems, source-specific equations or a different universal source.

proved_obstructions.scope: 139 additional coordinates are necessary and sufficient to compute b^(5^60) from b,b^2 in a triangular quadratic circuit on a common rational-function branch, allowing nonmonomial functions, divisions and rational roots of quadratic defining rows.
proved_obstructions.does_not_exclude: Simultaneously implicit systems, nonrational algebraic-function branches, extra source relations or a different universal source.

proved_obstructions.scope: The first linear congruence, all three Pell norms and one-quotient third-Pell equation with integral quotients do not force c integral.
proved_obstructions.witness_strength: Exact rational family with c=1/5 for every odd B>=3, plus a local continuation theorem at odd denominator primes.
proved_obstructions.does_not_exclude: A theorem using the full source identities and small-Pell closeness; no full-source counterexample is claimed.

local_arithmetic_results.generalization: Arbitrary indices at least two; signed witnesses; positive branch selected by one rational square.

local_arithmetic_results.scope: An explicit specialization works for every source polynomial and instance; the ninth input restriction cannot simply be dropped.

local_arithmetic_results.equivalence: b is a positive power of two and M divides binom(2r,r)

local_arithmetic_results.hypotheses: r>=1, M>=16, 2<=b<=2M, s!=0, signed corrected binomial equations
|a|>=2, B>=3 odd, |c|>B, i nonzero integral, two retained Pell norms and new one-quotient norm

local_arithmetic_results.conclusion: Same signed source projection; s=0 gives zeta^2=2 and is excluded before reciprocal reconstruction.
q and its geometric quotient are integral before exponent recovery; source growth then forces q=b^(5^60). Positive completeness is proved.
Signed prefix bounds force r>=M before recovering q>0; the retained eta margin absorbs the auxiliary Pell bound.
The identity a=(U+1)*sr allows p=2*a*sr-2*sr^2 and a unique inverse lift sr2=sr^2, with no guards.
local_arithmetic_results.scope: All three complete interfaces; unconditional algebraic equivalence, retained arithmetic premises for undecidability.

local_arithmetic_results.conclusion: The common Lucas point gives v2(T_i)=-4K-4. D=T_b/16 separates up to16 indexed contact blocks and stays fixed under reference changes.
local_arithmetic_results.scope: General and specified affine-contact systems; all retained arithmetic suppliers unchanged.

local_arithmetic_results.conclusion: The strengthened eta margin excludes s=0, and both first-Pell signs yield the absolute power relation and central-binomial divisibility. Signed auxiliary power recovery and fresh positive reconstruction preserve coding projection.
local_arithmetic_results.scope: General and abc short-power systems only; same arithmetic interfaces and source theorem.

local_arithmetic_results.conclusion: A guarded four-coordinate rechart places the retained second contact at progression index16 in the first gauge. Its square and fourth power replace two shared coefficients by affine substitutions and exact omitted-row identities.
local_arithmetic_results.scope: General and specified complete systems; rational zero-set equivalence with all old guards.
